title: Book Three · Chapter 178: Leo's Own Plan
story:
In early October, Ronan receives Leo's twenty-third reply.

About a month has passed since he posted his letter. Leo has been asking about work in his own city.

Now he has agreed to four Saturday mornings at a local shop. The owner will pay him and show him the stock records. The letter does not give the amount.

Leo wants to try the work before he chooses a longer course. He also writes about a friend who has already made a different choice.

Ronan reads that part slowly. Leo is making his own plans too.

Below it is a question about ordinary news.

Do you still play, or do you only write about cupboards now?

Ronan laughs. He folds the letter and puts it beside his birthday book.

That afternoon, he meets Anna at the old book shop near the market. He wants a small English phrase book for practice.

They find one with clear short examples. Ronan reads a page about a visitor and a room.

“This one,” he says.

It costs three yuan. He pays from his work money. At home, that envelope will hold sixty-nine instead of seventy-two.

Anna carries the book to the square while he puts the change away. They sit near the tree and open the first page.

“I would like a room,” she reads.

Ronan looks at the little picture beside the sentence.

“With a window?”

“And a door.”

“Any moving walls?”

She laughs and shakes her head. Then she asks the next question from the page.

Ronan can answer slowly. When she changes one word, he stops to think.

“Again?”

She repeats it, and he tries the answer with the new word.

After a while, they close the book. Anna tells him about a new maths question from her group. He gives her Leo's joke about the cupboards.

“He needs more fruit shops,” she says.

“I can send him yours.”

“A description.”

Ronan smiles. “A description.”

They walk as far as the market corner together. Anna turns toward Lin's home. Ronan takes his new book back to the green door.

He puts the three-yuan price beside today's date on his work envelope. The parents' study money and his old book-sale share stay in their own places.

Before dinner, he practises the visitor's first sentence once more. Mum hears him from the window and points toward the clear space beside his own chair.

“A room for your books first.”

He laughs and moves the little pile so Dad can set down the plates.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

stock record＝存货记录；phrase book＝常用语小册子；description＝文字描述；change＝找回的零钱。

## 理解问题

1. Leo自己答应了怎样的探索工作？是否回到Ronan同城或替他准备申请？
2. 英语小册子多少钱、从哪部分钱出？工资信封余额变成多少？

## 读句子

**He pays from his work money.**

拆开看：He / pays / from his work money.

他／付款／用自己挣来的工资。
